text: Talk to the Warrior south east of Draynor Village.
dialogue: What are you camped out here for?
What makes you think it's out here?
If it's hidden how are you planning to find it?
Looks like you don't know either.

text: Try cutting the tree just to the west.
dialogue: I've been in that shed, I didn't see a city.
I've been in that shed, I didn't see a city.

text: Bank all weapons and armour you have (including the axe), and go to Port Sarim to get a boat to Entrana.
Climb down the ladder on the north side of the island. Once you go down, you can only escape via teleport.
dialogue: Well that is a risk I will have to take.

text: Kill zombies until one drops an axe.
Attempt to cut a branch from the Dramen tree. Be prepared for a Tree Spirit (level 101) to appear, which you can safespot behind nearby fungus.
Kill the Tree Spirit. They can be safespotted behind nearby fungi to the east.
Cut at least one branch from the Dramen tree. It's recommended you cut at least 4 branches so you don't have to return in future quests.
Teleport away with the branches, preferably to Lumbridge.
If you've lost your Dramen branch/staff, you will need to return to Entrana and cut another. You will not need to defeat the Tree Spirit again.
Use a knife on the dramen branch to craft a dramen staff.
Enter the shed south of Lumbridge with your Dramen Staff equipped.
